claims.text: A hire purchase agreement is a financial agreement between the shop and the customer about how the customer will pay for the desired product.

claims.text: Most hire purchase agreements require a deposit to be paid before the customer can take the product.

claims.text: The principal amount of a hire purchase loan is the cash price minus the deposit.

claims.text: When a deposit is paid as a percentage of the cash price, first find the deposit as that percentage of the cash price (10% of R2500 = 250).
The principal P is the cash price minus the deposit (2500 - 250 = 2250), a new opening balance because the deposit is paid in cash.
The interest rate is written as a decimal in the formula (7,5 % p.a. is i = 0,075).

Substitute P, i and n into A = P(1 + in) to find the accumulated loan amount (A = 2250(1 + 0,075 x 2) = 2587,50).
The monthly repayment is the accumulated loan amount divided by the number of monthly payments (2587,50 / 24 = 107,81).

claims.text: Inflation is calculated using the compound interest formula, since the rate of inflation increases year on year.

claims.text: The compound interest formula used for inflation is A = P(1 + i)^n.
To find a future cost, take the current price as P, the inflation rate as a decimal i (9 % is 0,09) and the number of years as n.

To find a past cost, take today's price as A, the inflation rate as a decimal i (11 % is 0,11) and the number of years as n; the past price is the unknown P.

Calculate the monthly repayments on the hire purchase agreement: $\begin{align*}\text{Monthlypayment}&=\frac{\text{2587,50}}{24}\\&=\text{107,81}\end{align*}$
